# grove doctor: GitHub CLI version checks are tested offline

setup_workspace

env FAKE_GH_LOG=$WORK/gh.log
exec grove doctor
stderr 'No issues found'

env FAKE_GH_FAIL=--version
exec grove doctor
stdout 'gh version could not be determined'

cmp $WORK/gh.log $WORK/want-gh.log

-- want-gh.log --
["--version"]
["--version"]
